description_en: Queries the metering records for a specified cloud product
description_zh: 根据传入的云产品查询相应的计量记录
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-user-oms-data --table rds --data-type Hour --start-time 2020-02-20T12:00:00Z --end-time 2020-02-21T12:00:00Z --marker NextToken --page-size 1 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryUserOmsData

parameters.help_en: The product and details of the usage data. This is typically the `ProductCode`. Different products may have multiple metering models
parameters.help_zh: 用量数据产品和明细信息，一般为ProductCode，不同产品存在多种计量模型
parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the metering data. For more information, see the documentation for the specific product.

`Raw`: by hour.

`Hour`: by hour.

`Day`: by day.

`Month`: by month
parameters.help_zh:
计量数据时间类型，参考具体产品文档描述选用。
Raw：小时。
Hour：小时。
Day：天。
Month：月
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query.

The time must be in UTC and in the `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ` format, which complies with the ISO 8601 standard
parameters.help_zh:
请求的开始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准标示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式：yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

The time must be in UTC and in the `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ` format, which complies with the ISO 8601 standard
parameters.help_zh:
请求的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准标示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式：yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The position from which to start reading the query results. The results are returned in alphabetical order, starting from the entry that follows the `NextToken` value. If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从NextToken之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回。默认从头返回
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页行数，1~200，默认值100
parameters.name: page_size
